text: The Kestrel planning summary for 3–10 November includes corrections: archive max_workers is now 26, and tenant queue_depth is 440. Client requirements set webhooks max_workers to 20 and timeout_s to 40, audit ttl_s to 510, and search queue_depth to 90. The rollout order is webhooks before alerts, shipping before checkout, indexer before notify, and session before ledger. Ownership is split among alpha (webhooks), beta (tenant), gamma (alerts and export, which share a worker), and delta (auth). Hard rules forbid an archive-to-media dependency, a shipping dependency on inventory, and any alerts-to-gateway path. One coupling applies: an inventory ttl_s above 270 caps notify max_workers at 6. The linter, Rust rewrites, and a shared metrics library are still undecided. The security review is due at month's end, and the budget review has moved to next Thursday.
